import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react'; import { useParams } from 'react-router-dom'; import axios from 'axios'; export default function Invoice() { const { id } = useParams(); const [order, setOrder] = useState(null); useEffect(() => { axios.get(`http://localhost:5000/api/orders/${id}`).then(r => setOrder(r.data)).catch(() => {}); }, [id]); if (!order) return
Loading invoice...
; return (
✅ Order placed successfully!
🐔 WaleedVetCare

Sahiwal, Punjab, Pakistan
+92-300-1234567

Invoice #: {order.invoiceNumber}

Date: {new Date(order.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('en-PK')}

Status: {order.status}

Bill To:

{order.customer.name}

{order.customer.address}

{order.customer.city} {order.customer.postalCode}

📞 {order.customer.phone}

Payment:

{order.paymentMethod}

{order.items.map((item, i) => ( ))}
#ProductPriceQtyTotal
{i+1} {item.name} Rs. {item.price.toLocaleString()} {item.quantity} Rs. {(item.price * item.quantity).toLocaleString()}
SubtotalRs. {order.subtotal.toLocaleString()}
DeliveryRs. {order.deliveryCharges.toLocaleString()}
Grand TotalRs. {order.totalAmount.toLocaleString()}
Thank you for trusting Waleed VetCare! 🐔 Support: +92-300-1234567
); }
